ai_summary: Flexituff Ventures International Limited has defaulted on a substantial debt of over INR 236 crores owed to a consortium of lenders, leading UCO Bank to take symbolic possession of a significant commercial property under the SARFAESI Act. This action signals severe financial distress and a material loss of control over a key asset, indicating the company is undergoing serious debt recovery procedures which raise significant red flags regarding its solvency and future operations.
